criteria.rationale: Verified: on a clean checkout readGenerationFile falls back to the committed copies when generations/ is gitignored (.gitignore:27), so a matching set gives no finding. Unverified, accepted risk: there is no .gitattributes, so line-ending rewriting would make the set unavailable for every reader, not only the gate.

Examined check.go:147 and 479-493: the change only adds findings through the existing renderer and JSON path. Strict mode gets stricter only for a set no reader can use; the changelog records the change.

Under D1 (basis R1, R2) the gate reads only the set's structure through ReadIndexGeneration, which finds the harne8 state (descriptor not describing its files) without recomputing inputs. A stale set is not reported, as the spec intends.
Examined the new check: it is read-only, paths come from fixed index names under the root, the output holds only file names, generation ids and digests, and there are no secrets or authority changes.

17 lines reuse the existing reader. The smaller alternative (index --verify) costs about 20 s and flags normal staleness. The choice is invalidated if a commit leaves the set unreadable and still passes strict check, which the integration test guards for the unavailable branch.

findings.rationale: The R3 test asserts only that the tolerant output mentions the finding, not that it is a warning (exit code or finding state).

findings.rationale: Some reasons already end with '; run `pose index`' (index_generation.go:364), so the message repeats the fix; the reason stays English under the pt-BR locale.
